title: The 12:00 in one line: 19 decisions open, 17 include Dinis; the WS-96 table says whose word closes each
detail: First stand-up at 12:00 (the team's vote, recorded). 31 items are open, 19 of them decisions; 17 of the decisions include Dinis. Proposed order: (1) today's new decisions with a date: the 28 outreach emails waiting on Dinis's yes (WS-26) and personal business cards (WS-48), and who collects the garments; (2) Jose's site and UI issues to Angelo's and Dinis's dev agents (Jose reviews); (3) one line per row of the table in WS-96 ('whose word closes it'): WS-107, WS-34, WS-129 and WS-64 need Dinis and Angelo; (4) Silvio stuck at L3 (WS-35). Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>' so the record carries it; team-collaboration writes the record at 13:15.
